name: consort
description: Brings flags.consort NPCs (the Echelon's kept companions, Roxy & Bijou) to life. They live in a concealed boudoir off the owner's suite and only step out when the keeper `beckon`s them (keeper-only) to wherever he is aboard; `dismiss` — or the keeper stepping off the ship / logging off — sends them back into hiding. A 15s tick reads the live room. Roxy and Bijou each speak in their own register (a per-name VOICE table): Roxy the composed strategist who priced the deal and hates that she feels it, Bijou the romantic who fell hardest and watches the hatch. In the intimate cabins (suite/boudoir): when the one they're devoted to (flags.devoted_to handle) is alone with them, arousal builds and they slowly undress themselves (MIS-gated), murmur devotion, run tender two-hander banter, and — peaked, MIS on, keeper male — perform their signature fellatio scenes; a stranger cools them off, covers them up, and turns them shy. Reactive care: if the keeper comes back badly hurt the seduction stops and they tend him instead. Beckoned anywhere else aboard they instead live a life keyed to that deck (areaProfile off zone flags) — suntanning, soaking in the sun-deck jacuzzi, watching the water — holding each activity for minutes and rarely commenting. The `npc.talk` hook OPENS A REAL CONVERSATION for the keeper (renders each consort's dialogue_tree — flag-gated depth tiers about the deal, the feeling, the fear) and shyly deflects everyone else. No money, no pole — they're on the payroll.
